meta.name: depmap
meta.description: Query the Cancer Dependency Map (DepMap) for cancer cell line gene dependency scores (CRISPR Chronos), drug sensitivity data, and gene effect profiles. Use for identifying cancer-specific vulnerabilities, synthetic lethal interactions, and validating oncology drug targets.

copy.tagline: 查询癌症依赖图谱数据，发现肿瘤靶点
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在癌症研究中使用DepMap数据筛选基因依赖或药物敏感性。
copy.tagline_en: Query cancer dependency map data to discover tumor targets.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to analyze cancer gene dependencies or drug sensitivity data from DepMap.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会去查癌症依赖图谱 DepMap：通过 API 或下载的 CRISPR 基因效应、PRISM 药物敏感性等文件，给出各癌细胞系的基因依赖评分，并做选择性与合成致死分析。
howto.when: 当你要做癌症靶点验证、合成致死分析、生物标志物发现，或问某个基因在特定癌细胞系中的依赖性时触发。

say.text: 找出 BRCA1 突变细胞系里合成致死的基因
say.note: 比较突变与野生型细胞系的基因效应

say.text: KRAS 突变能否预测对某基因敲除的依赖？

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude can query the Cancer Dependency Map (DepMap) — through its API or downloaded files such as CRISPR gene effect and PRISM drug sensitivity data — to report gene dependency scores across cancer cell lines and assess selectivity and synthetic lethality.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you do cancer target validation, synthetic lethality analysis, biomarker discovery, drug sensitivity questions, or ask how dependent a gene is in specific cancer cell lines.

say_en.text: Get Chronos dependency scores for KRAS across lung cancer cell lines
say_en.note: Pulls that gene's dependency data via the DepMap API

say_en.text: Find synthetic lethal genes in BRCA1-mutant cell lines
say_en.note: Compares gene effect in mutant vs wild-type lines

say_en.text: Does KRAS mutation predict dependency on a given gene?
say_en.note: Runs a significance test between mutation and dependency
